description: Thank you to the Orange County Young Republicans for the opportunity to speak at last night’s meeting. It was great to connect with so many engaged young leaders who are passionate about the future of our communities, our state, and our country. I appreciated the chance to share more about our campaign and discuss the issues that matter most to Hudson Valley families. Thank you to the Orange County YRs for the warm welcome and for all you do to help our campaigns! 🇺🇸
